title: Detection of EGFR Mutation in Malignant Pleural Effusion of Lung Cancer Patients and Cancer Cell Lines Establishment
brief_summary: 1\. Detection EGFR mutation of cancer cells from malignant pleural effusion. 2. Established the cancer cell lines with without EGFR mutation from malignant pleural effusion.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All malignant pleural effusion related to NSCLC between April 2008 and March 2009.
* Older than 18 years old.
* The patients who received thoracentesis

Exclusion Criteria:

* The patients who are not compatible with inclusion criteria.
